name: Leonardo AI
desc: Image, video and 3D generation platform, now Canva's
desc_zh: 图像、视频与 3D 生成平台，已被 Canva 收购
solves: A production asset needs the right subject, the right style and the right size, and stock does not have it. Leonardo generates, then you tune.
solves_zh: 能上线的素材要主体对、风格对、尺寸也对，素材库给不了。Leonardo 先生成，再交给你调。
best_for: Game and product imagery that has to look finished and shipped, not merely sketched out.
best_for_zh: 游戏和产品图，要的是能直接用的成品感，不是一张草图。
